full_prompt_en: A square studio fashion photograph shows a full-length figure in layered earth-toned clothing against a plain deep brown wall. The background has no visible pattern or props; it grades gently from near-black at the outer edges to softer brown behind the subject. A pale gray floor forms a low horizontal strip at the bottom, grounding the figure with a quiet contact shadow. The person stands slightly left of center with feet close together, hands tucked into the outer coat pockets, and head turned toward the right. Short dark wavy hair frames a softly lit side view of the face. A long camel-colored coat hangs open from the shoulders and reaches well below the knees, its heavy matte fabric falling in broad vertical folds. Beneath it, a rust and cinnamon-toned vest or short jacket sits over a muted shirt, and wide terracotta trousers gather above pale lace-up boots. The layering gives the body a relaxed vertical shape, with the coat's lighter ocher edges separating from the darker inner clothing. Color stays within umber, tan, burnt orange, clay, and off-white, with no bright accent outside that family. Surface differences are subtle but legible: the coat looks dense and wool-like, the trousers softer and more folded, and the boots dry and lightly textured. A soft studio light from the upper right touches the face, shoulder, coat lapel, and toes; the left side stays darker, and the floor receives a restrained shadow. The overall composition is spacious and grounded, using large matte brown areas and restrained warm layering to make the standing figure feel natural and composed.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形影棚时尚照片呈现一位穿多层大地色衣物的全身人物，背景是纯净深棕墙面。背景没有可见纹样或道具，从外缘的近黑色轻轻渐变为人物身后较柔的棕色。底部一条浅灰地面水平延伸，以安静的接触阴影托住人物。此人站在中央稍左，双脚靠近，双手插在外套口袋里，头朝右转。短而微卷的深发围着受柔光照亮的侧脸。长及膝下的驼色外套从肩上敞开垂下，厚实哑光布料形成宽阔竖向褶皱。其下锈红与肉桂色背心或短上衣叠在低饱和衬衫外，宽松陶土红裤子在浅色系带靴上方收起。衣层赋予身体松弛的竖形，外套较浅的赭黄边缘从更深的内层衣服中分出。色彩始终处于深棕、棕褐、焦橙、陶土与灰白的家族内，没有跳脱其外的鲜亮重点。表面差异含蓄但可辨：外套厚重近似羊毛，裤子更柔且多褶，靴子干燥、略有肌理。柔和影棚光从右上方照到面孔、肩、外套翻领和鞋尖；左侧更暗，地面只接住克制的影子。整体构图疏朗而稳固，以大面积哑光棕色与克制暖色层叠，使站姿自然且从容。
style_prompt_en: An earthy photographic treatment relies on muted umber, camel, clay, rust, and chalky cream rather than high-chroma accents. Broad matte surfaces occupy most of the frame, with subtle grain, coarse fibers, porous material, and worn edges providing close texture. One upright focal mass is placed against a large plain dark field, leaving generous negative space. Soft light from one upper side warms exposed planes and separates neighboring browns by small value shifts; shadows remain deep but gentle, with restrained contact at the base. Folded and flat areas alternate to make quiet vertical rhythm, while the ground plane stays simple and stable. The composition feels spare, tactile, and composed, its richness coming from material and tonal nuance within a narrow warm range.
style_prompt_zh: 大地色摄影处理依靠低饱和深棕、驼色、陶土、铁锈红与粉白，而非高彩度重点。宽阔哑光表面占据画面大部分，细颗粒、粗纤维、多孔材质与磨损边缘提供近处肌理。一块竖向焦点形体置于大片纯净深色域前，留下宽裕负空间。一侧上方的柔光温暖受光平面，以细小明度差分开相邻的棕色；阴影深却温和，底部有克制的接触影。褶皱与平坦区域交替形成安静竖向节奏，地面则简单稳定。构图简省、可触且从容，其丰富性来自狭窄暖色范围内的材料和色调细节。
theme_en: A full-length fashion figure wearing layered earth-toned clothing against a dark studio wall
theme_zh: 一位穿多层大地色服装的全身人物站在深色影棚墙前
name: Earthy tones
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
